issues.failure_explanation: The GEP eigenvector is [-1; y]. The congruence gives W[0;v]=[α;v]. To obtain first component -1, one must scale by -1/α, yielding y = -v/α. The stated y = v/α gives x_k = -Q y_true, i.e., the negative of the MINBERR solution. This changes the backward error and invalidates the algorithm's output.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Change x_k = (1/α)Q_k v_min to x_k = -(1/α)Q_k v_min (or change the sign of the definition of α).
issues.overall_effect: Algorithm MINBERR as written returns the negative of the intended solution, failing to minimize backward error. This invalidates Theorem thm:minberrcost and Corollary c:minberr.
issues.title: Sign error in MINBERR solution formula in Lemma l:quotient
issues.why_classification: A one-sign local correction restores the correct MINBERR solution and all downstream guarantees, with no loss of mathematical content.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: The smallest eigenvalue $\lambda_{\min}$, which is nonnegative, is equal to the square of the backward error of the MINBERR solution, that is, $\lambda_{\min} =  (\berr_{\A,\b}(\x_k))^2$.

issues.failure_explanation: The smallest singular value σ_min of \tilde T_k equals min_{x∈K_k} ||A x - b||/||x||. The backward error is ||A x - b||/(||A|| ||x||). Thus berr = σ_min/||A||, not σ_min. The stated equality is false unless ||A||=1.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace σ_min by σ_min/||A|| in the backward error formula and check σ_min < ε||A|| in the algorithm.
issues.overall_effect: The convergence check in Algorithm MINBERR (step 5) and the claim in Corollary c:minberr that MINBERR finds ε backward error are off by a factor ||A||. For ||A||<1, the algorithm may stop with backward error > ε.
issues.title: Missing ||A|| factor in backward error formula in Lemma l:quotient
issues.why_classification: A short local correction (dividing by ||A|| or normalizing A) preserves all guarantees.
